segments.text: This VizieR metadata census asks which single tables intersect the abundance-search, stellar-mass, and redshift-search axes.
The search combined semantic UCD tags with column-name variants, and each frozen query returned exactly its pre-counted rows.
UCD plus name matching reached 5,568 tables on the abundance axis, 6,206 on mass, and 6,687 on redshift; name matching added 175, 88, and 20.
The three axis lists intersected at 178 candidate tables.
Modifier columns then emptied a required axis in 21 tables: 19 on redshift and 2 on abundance, leaving 157 recorded candidates.
As a side check, a frozen term regex matched 62 of those 157 recorded descriptions; it is not an eligibility filter, and T2 still applies to all 157.
All seven pinned recall members returned, while none of the three controls appeared.
Those checks validate retrieval, not precision: the frozen controls did not cover the dominant precision-contamination mode.

Recorded examples separate symbol-and-meaning collisions—Galactic height and model-grid metal fraction—from target-domain mismatches: stellar gravitational redshift and gravitational-redshift velocity. They are not T2 rulings.
The T2 rule contract is frozen, but the 157-table eligibility application is not completed, so no eligible-table count or metallicity measurement is reportable yet.

integration_constraints: Visual card durations are floors; narration duration may expand a card but must not compress below the visual floor.
No worker-lane audio synthesis is authorized.
No narration may call 62 eligible or describe the census as an MZR measurement.
No narration may call abundance-search-axis metadata reach adjudicated gas-phase abundance or evidence.
T1 retrieval controls and T2 contract-design decoys are distinct workflow stages and must remain labeled separately.
Use the final spoken script corresponding to the final Hwao storyboard, then run waveform and mux checks in the integrator lane.
Listening approval is a separate gate after synthesis and mux.
